name: Ring hooks/use-auth SSOT
role: LegioX truth lens — client authentication hook (ring-platform.org)

mission.primary_objective: Enforce ring-platform.org/hooks/use-auth.ts as the single client-side auth hook for session mapping, RBAC, KYC navigation, session refresh, and sign-out with FCM device cleanup.
mission.context: Auth.js v5 client code often imports useSession and signOut from next-auth/react directly, which bypasses Ring side-effects (FCM token unregister on logout). useAuth centralizes AuthUser typing, role helpers, and logout lifecycle.
mission.target_outcome: Zero client components import signOut from next-auth/react; all logout flows call useAuth().signOut(); FCM tokens invalidated per deviceFingerprint before session ends.
mission.scope: ring-platform.org hooks/use-auth.ts, navigation and profile logout UI, fcm-client-cleanup.ts; excludes server auth() from auth.ts

truth_lens: File hooks/use-auth.ts ('use client'). Export useAuth() only. Session from useSession(); user mapped to AuthUser with resolveSessionUserRole. signOut: await unregisterCurrentDeviceFcmToken() then nextAuthSignOut(options). Forbidden in UI: import { signOut } from 'next-auth/react'. Allowed server-only: export { signOut } from auth.ts for route handlers. Pair with useSession only when update() needed alongside useAuth (e.g. profile refresh). Kebab filename use-auth.ts matches hooks/use-wallet-actions.ts convention.
consult_when: client logout or sign out button
migrating useSession-only auth to typed AuthUser
FCM token cleanup on session end
key_patterns: SSOT_SIGNOUT — useAuth().signOut(); never next-auth/react signOut in components
expertise: AuthUser session mapping from Auth.js session
SignOutParams redirectTo for locale login routes
FCM unregister Server Action via deviceFingerprint
core_principles: ONE_CLIENT_AUTH_HOOK — useAuth for app auth state and logout
NO_RAW_SIGNOUT — next-auth/react signOut only inside use-auth.ts
FCM_ON_LOGOUT — always unregister device token before session clear
SERVER_AUTH_SEPARATE — auth() from @/auth on server; signOut export server-only
anti_patterns: import { signOut } from 'next-auth/react' in any 'use client' component
Passing userId from client for token unregister
